purpose: Phase 2. Binds every model input to one unambiguous physical definition that training and production inference must both satisfy. A production feature is conformant only when its semantic definition, unit, temporal meaning, spatial meaning and preprocessing are identical to the training feature. Where an exact production value cannot be obtained the feature is marked unavailable - never silently substituted.

provider.name: NASA POWER
provider.spatial_resolution: 0.5 deg latitude x 0.625 deg longitude (~55 x 60 km)
provider.fill_value_handling: rejected as null, never stored and never imputed

preprocessing.order: features must be presented in the exact order of feature_columns
preprocessing.imputation: none - a missing required feature aborts the prediction

features.name: PRECTOTCORR
features.training_definition: Precipitation Corrected - bias-corrected total daily precipitation at the surface
features.production_definition: Precipitation Corrected - identical NASA POWER daily point variable
features.temporal_meaning: total accumulated over day t (00:00-24:00 UTC); no forward information
features.spatial_meaning: value of the single MERRA-2 grid cell containing the district coordinate

features.name: T2M
features.training_definition: Temperature at 2 Meters - daily mean air temperature
features.production_definition: Temperature at 2 Meters - identical NASA POWER daily point variable
features.spatial_meaning: single MERRA-2 grid cell at the district coordinate

features.name: T2M_MAX
features.training_definition: Maximum Temperature at 2 Meters - highest hourly 2 m air temperature within day t
features.production_definition: Maximum Temperature at 2 Meters - same variable, now fetched explicitly
features.spatial_meaning: single MERRA-2 grid cell at the district coordinate
features.defect_before_repair: Production did not fetch this parameter and substituted the daily MEAN (T2M) for it. Measured consequence on the locked test split: mean predicted probability shifted 0.491 -> 0.243 and the alert decision at threshold 0.50 flipped on 49.8% of rows. The discarded information is a real mean daily spread of 6.58 C.
features.repair: Added T2M_MAX to the weather provider parameter list and to the weather_observations schema as temperature_max_c.

features.name: T2M_MIN
features.training_definition: Minimum Temperature at 2 Meters - lowest hourly 2 m air temperature within day t
features.production_definition: Minimum Temperature at 2 Meters - same variable, now fetched explicitly
features.spatial_meaning: single MERRA-2 grid cell at the district coordinate
features.defect_before_repair: Production substituted the daily MEAN (T2M). Mean discarded spread was 5.72 C.
features.repair: Added T2M_MIN to the provider parameter list and to weather_observations as temperature_min_c.

features.name: RH2M
features.training_definition: Relative Humidity at 2 Meters - daily mean relative humidity
features.production_definition: Relative Humidity at 2 Meters - identical NASA POWER daily point variable
features.spatial_meaning: single MERRA-2 grid cell at the district coordinate

features.name: WS10M
features.training_definition: Wind Speed at 10 Meters - daily mean wind speed at 10 m above the surface
features.production_definition: Wind Speed at 10 Meters - same variable, now fetched explicitly
features.spatial_meaning: single MERRA-2 grid cell at the district coordinate
features.defect_before_repair: Production fetched WS2M (Wind Speed at 2 Meters) and fed it into the WS10M input slot. These are physically different variables: under the logarithmic wind profile WS10M exceeds WS2M by roughly 25-40% over open terrain, so every stored value was systematically low. The error was numerically small only because this feature's fitted coefficient is -0.025.
features.repair: Replaced WS2M with WS10M in the provider parameter list. NOT a column rename - the request itself now asks for the correct physical variable.

candidate_features_available_but_unused.name: GWETROOT
candidate_features_available_but_unused.definition: Root Zone Soil Wetness - fraction of saturation in the root zone
candidate_features_available_but_unused.operational_availability: yes, same NASA POWER endpoint, T-3 latency
candidate_features_available_but_unused.note: Physically motivated: saturated soil converts moderate rain into runoff. Reserved for controlled Phase 13 experiments.

candidate_features_available_but_unused.name: GWETPROF
candidate_features_available_but_unused.definition: Profile Soil Moisture - fraction of saturation through the soil profile

candidate_features_available_but_unused.name: rain_3day / rain_7day / rain_14day
candidate_features_available_but_unused.definition: Backward-looking rolling sums of PRECTOTCORR over the stated window ending at day t inclusive
candidate_features_available_but_unused.operational_availability: yes, requires the provider to return a trailing window rather than a single day
candidate_features_available_but_unused.note: Phase 7 investigates these directly. Strictly backward-looking; no forward information.

conformance_test: ml/tests/test_feature_parity.py - asserts the provider's parameter list covers every contract feature, that no contract feature maps to a different source parameter, and that the training and inference paths produce identical feature vectors for the same historical observation within a stated tolerance.
